newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks rally in early trading.
newsitem.headline: French stocks rally in early trading.

text.p: French stocks surged at Wednesday's opening as the bourse tracked a third consecutive rise on Wall Street.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 38.89 points, or 1.51 percent, at 2,617.89 at 0810 GMT after opening 1.35 percent higher. It faces resistance around 2,624 points, brokers said.
The CAC-40 April futures contract was up 35 points at 2,617.
Traders said the rise was mainly derivatives-driven.
Volume in the first 30 minutes was 1.1 billion francs.
Shares in cosmetics group L'Oreal were 3.71 percent higher at 1,986 francs. Traders said a big brokerage raised its rating on the share.

L'Oreal's 57-percent owned Synthelabo pharmaceuticals subsidiary was up 2.77 percent at 630 francs. Its stock rose more than two percent on Tuesday after its chairman told analysts the group would derive half of the profits of its Lorax venture with Searle by the year 2000, up from 10 percent currently.
It had risen 6.4 percent the previous day on speculation of a linkup with another drug firm as part of the pharmaceutical industry's consolidation.
